transcribed_question:
9. LIST THE COMPONENT OF THE STRUCTURE FOUND THE AREA PAINTED BLACK
b. What Structure enters into the Pinned area

marker.description: A dark area painted on the anterior surface of the vertebral body

main_question: List the components of the structure found in the area painted black.
main_answer: The vertebral body (centrum) consists of a cancellous bone core surrounded by a thin layer of cortical bone.
main_explanation: The painted area covers the anterior aspect of the vertebral body. The body is the weight-bearing part of the vertebra, composed of spongy bone enclosed by a shell of compact bone.
